topic: Optimizing page loading and data requests
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on optimizing the process of fetching data upon page load. Initially, it was noted that two sequential API requests occur: one immediately upon loading, and a second one if user settings (specifically regarding iwh) are loaded. This sequence is deemed inefficient.

[p1] reported making changes to improve performance. While the overall page load time did not change significantly, subsequent requests still wait for the loading of user settings.

Later, [p1] addressed an issue where refreshing the page causes it to display incorrect data because it retrieves settings from user preferences rather than the URL parameters. [p1] also updated the iwh implementation and pushed the changes, noting that this parameter is also used within campaigns (specifically mentioning `/api/campaigns/target/total-traffic`).
decisions: The iwh implementation was updated and pushed.
The new iwh parameter logic will be applied to campaign targeting.
